cv.name: Hans Kristjan Veri
cv.summary: Full-stack engineer specializing in TypeScript and Python services with a background in applied cryptography. Builds secure, production web platforms end to end.

bullets: Owned end-to-end delivery for a B2B SaaS platform serving 2,000+ daily sessions across TypeScript and Python services.
Built secure REST and GraphQL APIs on AWS Lambda with OAuth 2.0/OIDC access control across API Gateway and S3.
Rebuilt onboarding into a guided single-page flow, raising completion from 50 to 90 percent.
Built core React features for Twilio Flex used by thousands of enterprise customers.
Introduced a strictly-typed component library and Kubernetes-based end-to-end tests in CI/CD, cutting regressions.

education.degree: M.Sc. in Computer Science, summa cum laude
